Create a Loro document

Source: R/doc.R
loro_doc.Rd

A loro_doc is a handle to a Loro CRDT document held in Rust. It has reference semantics: functions that edit a document modify it in place and return it invisibly, so copies made with = refer to the same document. Use doc_fork() for an independent replica.

Usage

loro_doc(peer_id = NULL)

Arguments

peer_id

Optional peer id identifying this replica: a whole number or a string of digits (peer ids are unsigned 64-bit integers, so large ids must be given as strings). A random id is used when NULL.

Value

A loro_doc object.

Examples

doc = loro_doc()
text_insert(doc, 1, "Hello")
text_get(doc)
#> [1] "Hello"

# the same, through a handle to the root text container
text = doc_text(doc)
text_push(text, " world")
text_get(text)
#> [1] "Hello world"
